slots.notes: Fullscreen looping hero background video that fills the right 50vw stage (.right-bg / .bg-image-wrapper) and, below 850px, the whole viewport. Rendered absolute inset-0 w-full h-full object-cover object-LEFT (focal point is the left edge of the frame), wrapped in a Framer Motion div that eases scale 1.06 -> 1 over 2.2s (goldEase). The clip-path split headline sits on top: white text reads over this footage on the right half and a mobile-only bg-black/20 darkening layer (md:bg-transparent) aids legibility under 850px, so footage should stay mid-to-dark on its left/center for white-text contrast. A defensive useEffect forces muted=true and re-calls play() on loadeddata. Supply as a seamless short loop; autoplay/loop/muted/playsInline/preload=auto.

Looping thumbnail video inside the floating 'Hidden Gems' card (.gem-image-box: a fixed 200x200px rounded-20px box, hidden below 1000px). Rendered absolute inset-0 w-full h-full object-cover, so it is cover-cropped to a near-square — supply roughly square or center-safe footage. autoplay/loop/muted/playsInline/preload=auto. The card itself enters with a Framer Motion y:60->0 / opacity 0->1, 1.1s, delay 0.5s.

Single Google Fonts family 'Inter' (weights 300/400/500, plus semibold used on the gem-card title) loaded via <link rel=preconnect> + stylesheet in layout.tsx <head>, and set on <body> via inline style fontFamily:'Inter', sans-serif plus the globals.css html,body rule. Serves BOTH display and body roles: the split-screen headline ('Discover the beauty' / 'of the world around' at text-[clamp(42px,6vw,80px)], font-light, tracking-[-0.04em], leading-[1.05]), the hero body paragraph (clamp 14-16px, font-light, leading-1.7, opacity-80), the navbar links (text-[13px] tracking-widest font-medium and the text-5xl/7xl mobile overlay links), and the gem-card 'Hidden Gems' title (font-semibold) + body. The tight tracking-[-0.04em] headline is tuned to Inter's metrics.

Four lucide-react component icons tinted via currentColor (no inline path data). [0] Star (size 30, fill=currentColor, strokeWidth 0) = the fixed top-left logo mark, with breakpoint-conditional color (home: max-[850px]:text-white / min-[851px]:text-black; tour-detail: white; menu-open: black). [1] Menu (size 32) = the fixed top-right hamburger (white on home/tour-detail else black, hover:scale-110). [2] X (size 32) = the mobile-overlay close button (hover:rotate-90). [3] ArrowRight (size 14) = trailing glyph on the gem-card 'Explore more' button. Swap to brand-equivalent lucide glyphs; the currentColor tint means retinting is a class change, not an asset edit.

mechanic: Split-screen 50/50-viewport hero where one identical HeroContent headline is rendered twice and revealed through hardcoded clip-path inset masks (inset(0 50% 0 0) black on the left half, inset(0 0 0 50%) white on the right) layered over a full-bleed object-left looping background video, with Framer Motion mask-line y:110%->0 headline reveals, a scale 1.06->1 video entrance, and a floating 'Hidden Gems' video card sliding up; below 850px the black side is hidden and the white side fills the viewport.
techDelivery: Multi-file Next.js 16.2.6 App Router project built with webpack (next dev/build --webpack, not Turbopack): React 19.2.4 + react-dom, framer-motion ^12.38.0, lucide-react ^1.14.0, gsap ^3.15.0 (installed but unused), Tailwind v4 (tailwindcss + @tailwindcss/postcss) with a hand-written app/globals.css, TypeScript 5.9.3; client components ('use client') for Navbar/HeroSection, Google Fonts Inter loaded via <link> in layout.tsx, empty default next.config.ts (no images.remotePatterns).
reskinNotes: The signature split-screen is structurally fragile: the two text layers MUST stay byte-identical because legibility depends on the left (.text-black-side, clip-path inset(0 50% 0 0)) and right (.text-white-side, clip-path inset(0 0 0 50%)) halves aligning pixel-for-pixel over a hardcoded 50vw/50vw .left-bg/.right-bg layout in globals.css — any copy or font-metric change that shifts wrapping breaks the seam, and the headline's tracking-[-0.04em] is tuned to Inter. The split collapses at the baked 850px breakpoint (left-bg + text-black-side become display:none, text-white-side goes clip-path:none full width) and the gem card hides its image at 1000px and re-docks fixed to the bottom at 850px, so the responsive rules are coupled to those exact pixel thresholds. Palette is baked into raw CSS/inline values and arbitrary Tailwind classes (#f3ebe4 background in globals.css + bg-[#f3ebe4] + the layout body, #1c1c1c headline/title, gem-card white + shadow with no border token, text-gray-500/black/40/opacity-80 muted greys, bg-black buttons) rather than CSS custom properties, so a brand palette swap is a find-and-replace across globals.css and multiple files. All copy is hardcoded in JSX/markup (metadata title 'Travel — Discover the World' + description, the 'Discover the beauty' / 'of the world around' headline lines, the hero paragraph, the 'Hidden Gems' title + body, the 'Explore more' label, and the 5 navbar link labels). The Star logo has breakpoint-conditional color logic (max-[850px]:text-white min-[851px]:text-black on home) that must be re-reasoned if the bg tone flips. The gem card uses fixed px dimensions (200x200 image box, 200px card height) rather than fluid sizing. goldEase = cubic-bezier(0.76,0,0.24,1) is the shared easing family across every entrance and should be preserved as the motion signature.
